fake-runner-token-value

Install container runner on Kubernetes

1. Add the container-agent Helm repository
   $ helm repo add container-agent https://packagecloud.io/circleci/container-agent/helm
   $ helm repo update
   $ kubectl create namespace circleci

2. Generate the Helm values
   $ export RUNNER_AUTH_TOKEN="<the token printed above>"
   $ circleci runner config my-org/new-runner --product container --token "$RUNNER_AUTH_TOKEN" --output values.yaml
   On CircleCI server, also set agent.runnerAPI in values.yaml to your server's URL.

3. Install container runner
   $ helm install container-agent container-agent/container-agent -n circleci -f values.yaml

Then run a job on it, in .circleci/config.yml:

version: 2.1

jobs:
  runner:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/base:current
    resource_class: my-org/new-runner
    steps:
      - run: echo "Hi I'm on Runners!"

workflows:
  build-workflow:
    jobs:
      - runner

Docs: https://circleci.com/docs/runner/container-runner-installation/
